consequence.statement: When strict-validate-path-type is enabled in ingress-nginx, its admission webhook validate.nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io rejects the challenge Ingress because the /.well-known/acme-challenge/<TOKEN> path contains a dot. The cert-manager controller then logs "Error presenting challenge", and the HTTP01 challenge cannot be solved.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.18.0, Ingress routes for ACME HTTP01 challenges use PathType Exact. This breaks with ingress-nginx >=1.8.0 when strict-validate-path-type is enabled, which is the default from ingress-nginx 1.12.0: its admission webhook rejects the challenge path because it contains a dot, so the challenge cannot be presented.
